record.reason: The paper studies transfer of length generalization through joint training on algorithmic tasks and observes related effects in pretrained LMs. It does not extend a deployed context window or reduce the compute/memory cost of long-context inference; the YaRN citation is adjacent context-length work but the proposed contribution is a training/generalization analysis.
record.title: Extrapolation by Association: Length Generalization Transfer in Transformers
